info.name: NGO Connect API v3.0
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for NGO Connect API. Covers all 64 APIs across 12 modules.

**Setup:**
1. Import this collection
2. Create an environment with variables: `baseUrl`, `accessToken`, `refreshToken`
3. Set `baseUrl` = `https://localhost:7001` (or your dev URL)
4. Run **Auth > Send OTP** then **Auth > Verify OTP** — the test scripts auto-set `accessToken` and `refreshToken`
5. All authenticated requests use `{{accessToken}}` from the Bearer Auth tab

**Modules:** Auth, Lookup, User, Settings, Organisations, Projects, Applications, Posts/Feed, Community/Polls, Donations, SOS, Notifications

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description: OTP-based passwordless authentication. JWT 15min + Refresh Token 30 days.

request.description: Send 6-digit OTP to mobile or email. Rate limited: max 3 per 10 min. recipient = mobile number or email address. purposeLkpId: 1=Login, 2=Register, 3=ForgotPassword, 4=ChangeEmail.
Verify OTP. On success: returns accessToken + refreshToken. Sets collection variables automatically.

exec: console.log('✅ Tokens saved. userId=' + j.data.userId + ' isNewUser=' + j.data.isNewUser);

request.description: Rotate refresh token. Old token revoked. Returns new accessToken + refreshToken.
Logout. Revokes the refresh token.

item.name: 📋 Lookup
item.description: Reference data. Cache client-side — changes infrequently.

request.description: Returns all LookupType codes: GENDER, SKILL, USER_ROLE, OTP_PURPOSE, ORG_TYPE, etc.
Replace GENDER with: SKILL, USER_ROLE, SKILL_PROFICIENCY, ORG_TYPE, OTP_PURPOSE, etc.
Full profile with PII (mobile, email). Own profile only.
PATCH semantics — null fields keep existing DB value (COALESCE in SP).
Public profile — no PII. Works for any userId.
Upsert by skill name — adds skill if new, restores if previously soft-deleted. DB: UserSkills.SkillName VARCHAR(100). No LkpId needed.
Remove a skill from own profile.

item.name: ⚙️ Settings
item.description: Platform configuration. Admin-editable. Cache-backed (zero DB reads on GET).

request.description: No auth required. Returns only IsPublic=1 settings. Safe for frontend.
Groups: OTP, AUTH, PAGINATION, FEATURE, DONATION, UPLOAD, PLATFORM, EMAIL.
Update any setting. Triggers SettingsCache refresh. Admin only.

item.name: 🏢 Organisations
item.description: NGO registration, profile, and member management.

body.raw:
{
  "orgName": "Helping Hands Foundation",
  "registrationNo": "MH-2024-NGO-001",
  "category": "Education",
  "about": "A foundation committed to rural education and healthcare.",
  "website": "https://helpinghands.org",
  "phone": "9800000001",
  "email": "contact@helpinghands.org",
  "city": "Pune",
  "state": "Maharashtra",
  "country": "India",
  "orgTypeLkpId": 1
}

request.description: Registering user is auto-added as FOUNDER (APPROVED). orgTypeLkpId: LookupValueId from TypeCode='ORG_TYPE'. Org starts with StatusLkpId=PENDING (awaiting verification).
Public. Returns org details with OrgType and MemberCount.
Org Admin/Staff only. PATCH semantics.
Public paged list. Filter by search text.
Returns members with role, fullName, and avatarUrl.
Org Admin/Founder only. roleLkpId: LookupValueId from TypeCode='MEMBER_ROLE' (FOUNDER/ADMIN/MODERATOR/MEMBER/VOLUNTEER). DB column: OrgMembers.RoleLkpId INT FK.
Soft-delete. Admin only.

item.name: 📁 Projects
item.description: Volunteer projects with QR-based session attendance.

body.raw:
{
  "orgId": {{orgId}},
  "title": "Tree Plantation Drive 2026",
  "description": "Plant 10,000 trees across Pune district.",
  "category": "Environment",
  "city": "Pune",
  "state": "Maharashtra",
  "projectTypeLkpId": 1,
  "locationTypeLkpId": 1,
  "joinTypeLkpId": 1,
  "maxVolunteers": 200
}

request.description: Org Admin/Moderator/Founder only. title maps to DB column ProjectName. projectTypeLkpId: TypeCode='PROJECT_TYPE'. locationTypeLkpId: TypeCode='LOCATION_TYPE'. joinTypeLkpId: TypeCode='JOIN_TYPE' (OPEN/INVITE_ONLY). No startDate/endDate on Projects — those are on ProjectSessions.
Public.
Org Admin/Moderator only. PATCH semantics. statusLkpId: LookupValueId from TypeCode='PROJECT_STATUS' (ACTIVE/COMPLETED/CANCELLED). DB column: Projects.StatusLkpId INT FK.
Public. OPEN projects only. Filter by orgId or search.

Org Admin/Moderator only. sessionDate: DATE. startTime/endTime: HH:mm (24-hour format). DB columns: ProjectSessions.SessionDate DATE, StartTime TIME, EndTime TIME. No Title or Location columns on ProjectSessions. SP auto-generates UUID QR code. QrExpiresAt = EndTime + 30 min.
Returns sessions with attendeeCount.
Returns QR token. Org Admin/Staff only. Encode this in a QR code image for volunteers to scan.
Volunteer check-in via QR scan. Prevents duplicate check-ins.

item.name: 📝 Applications
item.description: Volunteer applications to projects. Workflow: PENDING → APPROVED | REJECTED.

request.description: Project must be OPEN. Duplicate application rejected at DB level.

query.description: Optional. LookupValueId from TypeCode='APPLICATION_STATUS'. Leave empty to get all.

request.description: Org Admin/Moderator only. statusLkpId: LookupValueId from TypeCode='APPLICATION_STATUS' (PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED). DB column: ProjectApplications.StatusLkpId INT FK.

Org Admin/Moderator only. statusLkpId: LookupValueId from TypeCode='APPLICATION_STATUS'. note maps to DB column RejectionReason (stored for context on approval too). DB column: ProjectApplications.StatusLkpId INT FK.
All applications by the authenticated user across all projects.

item.name: 📰 Posts / Feed
item.description: Social feed — posts, likes, threaded comments, reports.

body.raw:
{
  "content": "Excited to announce our new tree plantation drive! Join us this July.",
  "orgId": {{orgId}},
  "mediaUrls": "",
  "postTypeLkpId": 1,
  "visibilityLkpId": 1
}

request.description: mediaUrls: comma-separated Azure Blob URLs (stored to PostMedia.FileUrl). postTypeLkpId: LookupValueId from TypeCode='POST_TYPE_FEED'. visibilityLkpId: LookupValueId from TypeCode='POST_VISIBILITY'. DB columns: Posts.PostTypeLkpId + VisibilityLkpId INT FK.
Paged feed ordered by CreatedAt DESC. Includes isLikedByMe.
Public. Single post detail.
Duplicate check at DB level.
Decrements LikeCount (min 0).
Set parentCommentId for threaded replies.
Public. Returns parentCommentId for client to build threads.
One report per user per post enforced at DB. reasonLkpId: LookupValueId from TypeCode='REPORT_REASON'. DB columns: PostReports.ReasonLkpId + StatusLkpId INT FK, ReportedByUserId (not UserId).

body.raw:
{
  "orgId": {{orgId}},
  "title": "Best practices for volunteer onboarding in rural areas?",
  "content": "Looking for insights on how to effectively onboard volunteers in remote locations with limited connectivity.",
  "postTypeLkpId": 1,
  "audienceLkpId": 1
}

request.description: orgId is required (NOT NULL in DB). title is required (NOT NULL, max 300 chars). postTypeLkpId: LookupValueId from TypeCode='POST_TYPE_COMMUNITY' (DISCUSSION/QUESTION/ANNOUNCEMENT/RESOURCE). audienceLkpId: TypeCode='POST_VISIBILITY' (defaults to ORG_MEMBERS). No Tags column in DB.
Public. All community posts and polls.

orgId required (NOT NULL in DB). options: array of strings (min 2). expiresInHours: poll expires via PollEndsAt = NOW() + hours (DB column: CommunityPosts.PollEndsAt). No IsPoll or ExpiresAt columns — type is determined by PostTypeLkpId=POLL.
One vote per user per poll. Poll must not be expired.

item.name: 💰 Donations
item.description: Fundraising campaigns with Razorpay integration. Recurring donations. 80G receipts.

body.raw:
{
  "orgId": {{orgId}},
  "title": "Flood Relief Fund — Maharashtra 2026",
  "description": "Providing emergency relief to flood-affected families in Kolhapur district.",
  "goalAmount": 500000.00,
  "startDate": "2026-07-01",
  "endDate": "2026-08-31",
  "bannerUrl": "",
  "campaignTypeLkpId": 1
}

request.description: Org Admin/Founder only. title maps to DB column CampaignName. goalAmount maps to DB column TargetAmount. startDate required (DB column: DonationCampaigns.StartDate DATE). campaignTypeLkpId required: LookupValueId from TypeCode='CAMPAIGN_TYPE' (GENERAL/PROJECT/EMERGENCY/RECURRING).
Public. ACTIVE campaigns with progressPct.
Public. Full detail with progressPct and donorCount.

body.raw:
{
  "campaignId": {{campaignId}},
  "amount": 500.00,
  "note": "Glad to help the flood victims.",
  "isAnonymous": false,
  "payMethodLkpId": 1
}

request.description: Returns donationRef (DON-2026-000001) + razorpayOrderId + transactionId. payMethodLkpId: LookupValueId from TypeCode='PAYMENT_METHOD' (UPI/CARD/NET_BANKING/WALLET). SP returns DonationRef, RazorpayOrderId, Amount, TransactionId (no IsSuccess/Message). Use razorpayOrderId with Razorpay SDK to collect payment.
C# layer verifies HMAC-SHA256 signature first. SP marks COMPLETED and increments RaisedAmount.
Own donation history.
80G receipt data. donationId: INT (auto-increment PK from DonationTransactions table). SP Donation_GetReceipt takes p_DonationId not p_DonationRef. Only COMPLETED donations. Only own receipts.

orgId required (NOT NULL in SP). startDate required: first billing date (DATE). frequencyLkpId: LookupValueId from TypeCode='RECURRING_FREQUENCY' (WEEKLY/MONTHLY/QUARTERLY/YEARLY). DB column: RecurringDonations.FrequencyLkpId INT FK. SP returns RecurringDonId. Processed by Hangfire background job.
Ownership check in SP.

item.name: 🆘 SOS
item.description: Emergency alert system with live GPS tracking. Live location updates via SignalR (not REST).

request.description: Any existing ACTIVE SOS for this user is auto-resolved before creating new one. alertTypeLkpId: LookupValueId from TypeCode='SOS_ALERT_TYPE' (SOS/HELP_REQUEST/MISSING_VOL/SAFE_ARRIVAL). DB column: SosIncidents.AlertTypeLkpId INT FK (was SosType VARCHAR). SP returns SosIncidentId.
Returns all active SOS incidents visible to the current user. DynamicRow — shape driven by SP.
Only the triggering user can resolve their own SOS. resolvedByLkpId: LookupValueId from TypeCode='SOS_RESOLUTION_TYPE'. DB column: SosIncidents.ResolvedByLkpId INT FK (was ResolutionNote VARCHAR).
No request body needed — SP Sos_Respond takes only p_SosIncidentId + p_UserId (from JWT). Cannot respond to own SOS. One response per user per SOS.
High-frequency endpoint. Call every 10 seconds. accuracy: GPS accuracy in metres (optional). Writes to SosLocationLogs (BIGINT PK).

item.name: 🔔 Notifications
item.description: In-app notifications and FCM device token management.

request.description: Paged, most recent first.
Ownership check — can only mark own notifications.
Bulk update — marks all unread for the authenticated user.
Upsert per (UserId, Platform). platform: ANDROID | IOS | WEB.
